LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.EnableAllInsectsAssaul: When enabled, attacking any insect will cause ALL insects on the map to switch to assault colony mode.
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.EnableDeathReinforceme: When enabled, insect deaths may trigger reinforcements from nearby hives
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.DeathScanRadius.Descri: Radius to scan for remaining combatants around dead insects
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.CombatantThreshold.Des: Random range for minimum combatants needed to allow reinforcements
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.HiveReinforcementRadiu: Radius to scan around hives for potential reinforcements
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.ReinforcementCount.Des: Random range for number of reinforcements to call
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.AggroRadius.Descriptio: Distance within which insects will automatically target enemies, even without being marked as original aggressors.
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.AssaultRadius.Descript: When 'All Insects Assault' is enabled, only insects within this distance of an attacked insect will switch to assault mode.
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.ForgetAggressorTime.De: How long insects remember their aggressors. After this time, they may return to normal behavior if no other threats remain.
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.CleanupInterval.Descri: How often the mod checks for defeated aggressors to clean up. Lower values = more responsive but slightly more performance impact.
LanguageData.SKBugOff.Settings.DisabledMessage: When disabled, insects will only respond individually to attacks instead of coordinating a colony-wide response.
